visualStyleNotes: Geometry, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A flat board carrying a thin straight stroke with arrowheads at both ends and two labeled points. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Board: warm paper panel (roughness ~0.5). Line stroke: thin warm-ink strip (roughness ~0.4). Arrowheads: small warm-ink triangles. Points: small warm-ink spheres with paper label tags. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: lines as infinite straight paths — a thin stroke with arrowheads both ends passes through points A and B on a board; an 'extend' control pushes the drawn path longer both ways.

GEOMETRY: A flat board with a straight thin stroke running across it. Small arrowhead triangles at both drawn ends. Two labeled dots A and B sit on the stroke and can be dragged along it. An 'extend' button animates the stroke growing longer at both ends simultaneously; a 'slide' mode moves the whole stroke vertically while keeping it straight.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) board; (2) line stroke; (3) arrowheads; (4) points A and B.

CAMERA: three-quarter from above-front, frames the full board; labels legible. Budget 4-8k triangles. Named nodes: Board, LineStroke, Arrowhead_L, Arrowhead_R, Dot_A, Dot_B, ExtendButton. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
